title: An unknown or unavailable attribute never matches a restriction it was not explicitly selected for
mechanism: Attribute<T> has no Unknown variant; the provider's explicit 'not specified' is a distinct Unspecified state

commands.command: cd frontend && corepack pnpm@11.7.0 run typecheck

commands.note: result PASS, cleanup PASS; no new migration in WP-04

commands.command: cd backend && cargo +1.88.0 test --locked -p concert-application --test identity_claims
cd backend && cargo +1.88.0 test --locked -p concert-service --test claims_adapter

cases.what: an age-bound audience denies a viewer whose age is Unavailable (row 7)
a gender-bound audience denies a viewer whose gender is Unavailable
an audience of gender unknown admits exactly the provider's explicit 'not specified' answer (row 11)
an audience of gender unknown denies a viewer with a known female or male claim
an expired claim is Unavailable and never falls back to an older claim
a revoked or replaced claim is Unavailable
a viewer with no claim row at all is Unavailable
a transport failure is Unavailable and never a default
a claim read never renders an age or a birth date through Debug
a malformed reply (unknown status or gender string) is refused rather than coerced
cases.test: claims_adapter: gender_attribute and age_attribute reject unknown values

cases.what: an audience of gender unknown with an age bound requires both attributes
a viewer whose age is known but whose gender is Unavailable is still age-checked
cases.test: claims_adapter: viewer_attributes keeps a known age when the gender is unavailable

cases.what: the SQL predicate and the pure function agree on every unknown-attribute case

limitations: The claim adapter's reply is exercised through a fake IdentityClaimsPort in these tests; the gRPC transport itself is covered by the profile-service server compiling and its method policy, not by an end-to-end RPC in this suite.
